title: Mucalin
summary: Mucalin is a snake-like Yama-Titan with seven heads much like the Greek Hydra. A similar Titan, Hydramaskar, influenced Aztec mythology where Mucalin influenced Buddhist mythology. Mucalin also appears to be related to another orange cobra-like Titan, Slitherfang.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Mucalin has been seen to be used by [[Zhalia Moon]]. {{Source|TCG:LGS-012|LGS-012}}

It fought a [[Sekhmet]] [[Titan]] alongside [[Freelancer]]. However, Sekhmet used one of Mucalin's seven heads to bite Freelancer's arm. {{Source|TCG:OAL-060|OAL-060}}

full_text:
Mucalin is a snake-like Yama-Titan with seven heads much like the Greek Hydra. A similar Titan, Hydramaskar, influenced Aztec mythology where Mucalin influenced Buddhist mythology. Mucalin also appears to be related to another orange cobra-like Titan, Slitherfang.

History

Mucalin has been seen to be used by Zhalia Moon. [LGS-012]

It fought a Sekhmet Titan alongside Freelancer. However, Sekhmet used one of Mucalin's seven heads to bite Freelancer's arm. [OAL-060]

Abilities

Mucalin's Intervene ability allows it to act as a shield for another Seeker or Titan.
